title: The Work After the Output
treatment: Repaired DRAMATIST, independent scorer selection received before this plan. Enthusiast output-credit scene and Explainer mechanism distinction grafted.

palette.name: oxblood porcelain petrol copper nickel
palette.why: Porcelain document stock and copper work surfaces give useful preparation a warm, tactile setting. The oxblood pen is the repeated human tool. Petrol belongs to the retrieval cabinets, not to a default blue technology world. Nickel distinguishes durable mechanisms from editable paper.
palette.divergence: September12 used lilac, ivory, citron, coral and violet around an EEG notebook. September11 used cream, spruce, berry and proof gold around a flight crate. This film is dominated by copper work surfaces, porcelain stock and a long oxblood writing instrument; green is restricted to cabinet hardware.

light.direction: Upper left key rakes down and right across desks; object shadows fall toward the lower right.
light.key: Warm broad window light. Tops are porcelain-bright, front faces retain their material color.
light.fill: Muted neutral fill from the right keeps dark pen and cabinet side walls legible.
light.rim: Thin nickel-white edge on the nib, cap collar, paper corners and report tabs.
light.depth: Four to six real Stage3D planes at each set: rear architecture, task furniture, mechanism, carried documents, professional tool and foreground occluder. Contact shadows attach every object to its receiving surface. Far layers reduce contrast and chroma; the foreground remains crisp.
light.why: The light follows completed outputs from machinery into a welcoming working desk, so the human handoff feels like the next useful action. It does not imply a failed machine or a threat.

shape_language.mechanisms: Rectangular slotted trays, notched record tabs, repeated cabinet rails and round API connectors. Their right angles express gathering and organizing.
shape_language.human_tool: One long tapered pen with cap, sprung clip, collar and split nib. Its diagonal cuts across the document's parallel lines when refinement begins.
shape_language.documents: Straight ruled report with source tabs versus an explicitly labeled FIRST DRAFT whose neutral paragraph lines can reflow. They never become generic identical pages.
shape_language.why: The two machine mechanisms and their different outputs remain distinguishable in silhouette before any explanation.

hero.asset: PenAndDocument pen extended as reusable ReviewPen
hero.reason: An ordinary faceless professional tool supplies a concrete promised action and actual cap, nib and ink states. No employment or cultural claim.

supporting.reason: A generic hand must physically carry, inspect, uncap and guide each intended action, with continuous contact rather than a floating pen.
Supporting source records and output stock, never the hero or yesterday's notebook.
Shelf office detail restricted to the retrieval room; other worlds have independent furniture and compositions.
Material identity labels for KGS and provenance, with mobile-size typography.
Real depth reveals which tool made which output and where that output goes next.
Source and licensed music attribution remains legible for at least ten seconds after narration.

casting.new_asset_gap: The shelf's PenAndDocument pen only hovers and never writes. Extend that existing object family with a reusable cap/clip/nib/contact/ink performance API. No invented character, culturally coded scenery or personified Koniag institution.

motion_language.primary: Every narrated action has a beat-driven spring with anticipation and a single overshoot. API tabs travel through connected channels; rule rails physically align retrieved records; generated lines grow only in the separately named Jumpstarter bay.
motion_language.reaction: Tabs displace their tray stops, report arrival nudges the pen cradle, an uncapped pen releases its sprung clip, a held pen's nib shares the hand's path and reveals ink only at contact. Reactions lag primary impact by two to four frames.
motion_language.ambient: Separated cabinet tags, task-light suspension, loose paper edges and pen-cup spring each have quiet phase-offset life. Motes and a slow window-shadow sweep supply atmosphere. All motion freezes together for the three reveal reading holds.
motion_language.camera: Compose truckAcross and dollyThrough on record travel, craneDown plus orbitReveal on the review desk, and riseWith plus orbitReveal on the whole-output reveal. Keep the readout copy outside perspective transforms.
motion_language.blur: Short directional blur only on drawer pulls, cap flips and scene wipes. Nib-to-paper contact and small type remain sharp.
motion_language.why: Physical cause and consequence makes office automation visible. No fake errors, queues, approval stamps or timing effects are needed.

worlds: retrieval cabinet aisle and API cutaway
composition.hierarchy: One primary action at center. The pen reads at70percent of the hook frame; tool/output labels are secondary and provenance is a steady tertiary layer. The mechanism room uses landscape rails, the drafting room uses vertical expansion, and the human desk uses a diagonal working gesture.
composition.safe_area: Load-bearing objects and all story labels stay x70..1010 and y480..1320, safe inside the central square crop. Open captions exclusively occupy y1336..1468. Eyebrow and material decoration may extend beyond the square but never carry an essential fact.
composition.scales: Insert, close, medium, wide and extreme-wide. At least low, eye, high and overhead camera heights. Adjacent shots change world composition, not just zoom.
composition.signature_shot: At the Act3 reset, machine housings withdraw to two far depth planes while their intact outputs move into a generous foreground workbench. The gathered report and editable first draft command the picture, then the pen's diagonal action cuts through their previously parallel paper lines.
composition.why: The film grants completed preparation real scale and beauty before following each documented professional action. The last image contains both useful outputs and a visible human refinement mark.

craft_advance.system: Reusable professional pen articulation and contact-bound editing
craft_advance.change: Add cap separation/posting, clip flex, hand-controlled nib position and a progressive neutral annotation stroke to the shelf pen family. Ink must end exactly at the current nib tip and remain after the pen lifts. Preserve legacy PenAndDocument defaults for shipped episodes.
craft_advance.verification: At roughcut stage inspect consecutive frames of uncapping, cap seating, contact and lift. At final QA verify ink ends at nib, hand remains attached, cap has a consistent path and the last state differs physically from the capped opening.
